contexts.text: The words... they excite or draw out from man's memory... AC 8159. AC 9272:5.
It expresses its delight... in another way.
In the other life it is not allowable to draw out such things... HH 465.
They cannot draw out a single syllable...
It is afterwards taken out from the memory, and committed to life.
Man takes with him all the natural memory... but he can draw nothing out of it...
From the memory of another may be drawn out the minutest particulars.
